title: P2.1 / A1–A2 — Low-friction ordinary Companion use and approval-boundary clarity
body:
## Approved next slice — 2026-10-08 KST

The user approved proceeding after reporting repeated approvals while Codex used additional threads/processes. Primary owner: #1212/P2.1; coordination #1209; related progression and burden owner #1214. This is a small A1/A2 entry-usability slice, not all of A1–A6 and not a new permission framework.

**Outcome:** after an explicit task scope and any genuinely necessary one-time setup, an agent can use the existing installed Companion to resume, read relevant notes, make an authorized useful work revision and read it back without unnecessary shell diagnostics, manual context/token copying, per-step fresh sessions or repeated semantic confirmation. Actual out-of-scope actions still require their existing authorization or refuse.

ChatGPT/user own this outcome and evidence interpretation. Codex owns current-source diagnosis, the smallest sufficient implementation/configuration choice, tests and at most one Draft PR. Do not stop at another broad audit when a justified in-scope correction is available.

## Current basis and observations

Fresh authenticated main at commissioning: `42f3a4569b30c344a0a474483b79a78faf8de078`, tree `22e285a5fc847cbdace137fff28aa6ff17af9547`. Open PR listing is empty; no dedicated open approval-usability slice was found. Recheck at execution; this is not a forced checkout or a reservation of the Mac.

#1417/#1418 first-work implementation and bounded installed adoption remain complete. Preserve [the settled acceptance](https://github.com/hynk-studio/augnes/pull/1418#issuecomment-6044142610) and [ordinary-use checkpoint](https://github.com/hynk-studio/augnes/pull/1418#issuecomment-6041814468). Do not repeat installation, genesis creation or the original Canonical campaign to reopen that completion.

The submitted adoption reports distinguish a newly created Codex app session used to load refreshed tools from a separate Node/MCP readback process. They report host gates for GitHub reads, process inspection, folder creation, lease verification and readback, and a later user-selected Full Access mode. They do not retain a complete per-prompt/effective-policy map or an exact total click count. The approximately 104-minute save-to-readback interval includes approval waiting and is not product latency. Do not assume every gate was necessary, every gate was an Augnes defect, or that a new app thread is a spawned subagent.

One source-visible entry gap is already identified: [the current usage contract](https://github.com/hynk-studio/augnes/blob/42f3a4569b30c344a0a474483b79a78faf8de078/docs/CODEX_MCP_AUGNES_BRIDGE_USAGE_V0_1.md) describes initial-work and different-task authoring, but [the installed-plugin continuity skill source](https://github.com/hynk-studio/augnes/blob/42f3a4569b30c344a0a474483b79a78faf8de078/plugins/augnes-operator/skills/augnes-live-repository-continuity/SKILL.md) omits those branches and emphasizes Resume/managed attachments. Current revision guidance already says an authorized note update needs no new confirmation ceremony. The omission is a concrete guidance candidate, not an established cause of historical host prompts. Actual tool descriptors may supply information absent from the skill.

The [existing plugin transport](https://github.com/hynk-studio/augnes/blob/42f3a4569b30c344a0a474483b79a78faf8de078/plugins/augnes-operator/.mcp.json) starts the per-session stdio proxy. That established capability is different from repeatedly launching ad hoc shell/SDK clients. Preserve its authenticated discovery and runtime-identity checks.

Official [permission guidance](https://learn.chatgpt.com/docs/permissions) distinguishes local sandboxed commands from MCP/server, connector and browser controls. [Subagent guidance](https://learn.chatgpt.com/docs/agent-configuration/subagents) describes inheritance of the parent's current permission mode/runtime overrides; independent app-thread creation must not be assumed equivalent. Verify support and effective behavior in the actual installed client instead of copying current documentation syntax into an older binary. The repository's managed-runtime qualification is not an inventory of the external Codex app/CLI used here.

## Bounded diagnosis and smallest change

1. Inspect relevant current owners and the existing narrow adoption artifacts. Recover available command/tool, session/process class, working-directory/resource class, effective policy, requested grant and outcome for the reported gates. Separate installation/onboarding, ordinary product use and development/acceptance diagnostics. Keep missing historical details unknown; exhaustive reconstruction is not a prerequisite. Do not read broad transcripts, hidden reasoning or unrelated private configuration to fill gaps.

2. Inspect the actual app/CLI version, loaded tool catalog and effective task-relevant permission layers through supported read surfaces. Diagnose the ordinary installed MCP path directly before prescribing more filesystem/network access. A sandboxed diagnostic helper that cannot verify host processes is not proof the service needs repair. Do not remove process, identity, source-currentness or credential checks to make such a helper green.

3. Correct the existing operator guidance for ordinary work: lifecycle/Resume, no-work initial preview/define, existing-work revision, and explicit different-task preparation when appropriate. Keep managed execution/Browser-confirmed grants a separate optional branch, not a prerequisite to storing notes. Clarify which steps are installation-only or developer diagnostics. Reuse existing skill and usage owners; no second masterplan, general wizard or universal agent schema.

4. If a supported task/session-scoped configuration is sufficient, use that rather than add runtime code. The approval covers a narrowly described opt-in configuration for this task through normal client controls. Preserve account/model, unrelated settings and managed policy; show the exact effective scope. The agent may not approve its own gate or silently edit global policy. If only a persistent/broader change is supported, report its exact proposed diff for the user's separate decision rather than apply it. Do not assume local command profiles constrain MCP or browser actions.

5. Only when the ordinary path reveals an actual adapter defect, implement the smallest cause-bound correction in the existing owner and test that behavior. Preserve wire compatibility and trust boundaries. If current code already suffices, a guidance/configuration result with actual observations is acceptable; do not manufacture a runtime patch or cosmetic PR. A runtime/security redesign requires a separate scope decision.

## Ordinary-path observation

Use the current capable session by default. Do not require a new worker for each stage or a standalone SDK process solely to repeat #1418's successful persistence test. One necessary fresh session to load a supported profile or changed tool inventory is different from a recurring product requirement; record it as setup. No automatic thread factory or extra orchestration layer.

For one small useful task, exercise the actual installed tools: Resume → needed current-source read → authorized revision preview → inspect → save → fresh Resume/source read. Preserve preview/save separation while allowing already-authorized technical operations to proceed without additional semantic approval. Honor stale/conflicting/unknown outcomes; this is not permission to refresh-and-save automatically or send a replacement write.

Prefer reusing the retained task-owned `Web continuation readiness` project when the proposed update genuinely belongs to its purpose. Keep its original goal, six notes and hosted deferral intact. If a different task is needed, use existing explicit preparation with proper note-selection reasons, or at most one dedicated task-owned ordinary project through supported onboarding; do not repurpose unrelated projects or manufacture an empty state. Save only a substantive new finding or useful clarification, not a dummy success marker. A disposable fixture can test mutation boundaries but is not installed ordinary-use evidence.

Where needed, select the task project once through the normal currentness-checked owner and restore the prior selection afterward only if no user change intervened. Do not loosen existing selection-coupled write eligibility to eliminate that explicit action.

The user specifically raised subagents: inspect actual inheritance first. At most one narrowly tasked read-only subagent observation is allowed if supported and useful to resolve a remaining inheritance/tool-access question. It may read the same authorized project through the installed tools; the parent owns writes. Record actual tool availability, parent/child effective permissions and any gate, without treating a read-only instruction as an enforced MCP access restriction. An independent new app thread or helper process is not evidence of child inheritance. Unsupported child tools should be reported precisely; do not compensate with a swarm or credential relay. Subagents are not a dependency for ordinary single-agent use.

## Acceptance and honest limits

- Document a short normal path and its real prerequisites. A user should not have to know packet IDs, database paths, credentials or an internal diagnostic script.
- Observe actual successful work/readback and count host approval events separately from semantic questions, one-time setup, project onboarding and development diagnostics. Record scope and duration of any approval. Unknown historical counts stay unknown; no invented before/after percentage.
- The target is no additional avoidable approval inside the declared, already-authorized routine path under a verified restricted client posture. Record every remaining interruption and the exact unsupported boundary. Full Access-only success does not qualify the restricted path. Never obtain zero prompts by disabling approval globally, using unrestricted execution, broadly trusting all shell/Node/MCP actions, hiding refusals or bypassing managed policy.
- Verify affected contracts and denial/stale/unknown behavior with harmless bounded tests. Do not read real secrets or write outside the approved task as a negative test. Authentication, source/provenance disclosure, project isolation and meaningful outside-scope approval remain intact.
- Guidance alignment, configured access, actual loaded-client behavior and reduction in user burden are separate results. A wording patch alone does not prove fewer prompts; one successful local path does not prove cross-session, independent-operator or all-harness portability.
- Development iteration is permitted when evidence changes the diagnosis. Do not repeat a blocked invocation, create new sessions, or broaden permissions until something passes. If a supported user-controlled setup action is necessary, surface that one concrete action rather than ask again for the entire approved scope.

## Work boundaries and delivery

Use current AGENTS and relevant active owners. The Mac's actual installed-client observation belongs at the existing canonical host; source work must preserve checkout/runtime ownership and unrelated changes. No lock absence alone proves a free window. Use existing lifecycle/cleanup owners only when needed, leave the intended Companion running, retain authorized ordinary results, and reuse existing preservation evidence. Do not make a 136-table audit, keep-awake lease, reinstall or independent-process reader a mandatory step of every ordinary use.

Allowed: bounded source investigation, relevant skill/usage/adapter changes, supported task-local configuration within the scope above, one ordinary-use observation and the optional single child read, focused development checks, required exact-final-head planner-selected verification, intended branch/commit/push and at most one Draft PR. Keep any unmerged candidate in the development/test path; do not overwrite the live installed plugin with it. Candidate source checks and observations of the existing installation must be labeled separately; production adoption of a changed artifact follows review/merge, not a hidden hotfix.

Do not rerun old Full Canonical merely to confirm status. New tracked changes follow the real current planner and policy; docs-only changes are neither automatically full-runtime tests nor automatically exempt authority changes. Retain failures and exact-head evidence.

Excluded: automatic Full Access, global permission/account edits, new keys/provider experiment/model upgrade, new activity or authorization store, arbitrary remote executor/tunnel, production migration, hosted/Sites/Cloudflare operations, Autohunt implementation, merge/Ready/auto-merge, historical evidence deletion and whole-roadmap reconciliation. #1372 remains a separate owner, not a gate for this work.

Return the actual cause classification, the useful simplified path, applied versus proposed configuration, minimal diff or no-code reason, source/client/profile/artifact identities, routine/setup/diagnostic prompt accounting, actual work and optional child results, tests/NOT_RUN, preservation and cleanup. Provide a concise sanitized issue/PR result; keep private paths, credentials, broad logs and user notes out of public evidence. End with the next product action, not a new indefinite permission-audit program. Registering this commission is not a claim that ChatGPT launched Codex or changed the Mac.
